question: Let $f(x)=7x^{11}+4x^5-3$. Then $f$ has
solution: $f'(x)=77x^{10}+20x^4>0$ for $x\ne0$. Also $\lim_{x\to\infty}f(x)=\infty$ and $\lim_{x\to-\infty}f(x)=-\infty$. Thus there is at least one real root, and $f$ is monotone (apart from the stationary point at $0$), so there is exactly one real root.
